mapper.select: SELECT * FROM MOVIE ORDER BY MOVIE_ID ASC

SELECT MOVIE_ID as movieId, TITLE, ORIGINAL_TITLE as originalTitle, DIRECTOR, GENRE, RELEASE_DATE as releaseDate, RUNNING_TIME as runningTime, RATING FROM MOVIE ORDER BY MOVIE_ID DESC OFFSET #{skip} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MOVIE ( MOVIE_ID, TITLE, ORIGINAL_TITLE, DIRECTOR, ACTORS, GENRE, RELEASE_DATE, RUNNING_TIME, RATING, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_MOVIE.NEXTVAL, #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{originalTitle, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{director, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{actors, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{genre, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{releaseDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{runningTime, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{rating, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE MOVIE SET TITLE = #{title}, ORIGINAL_TITLE = #{originalTitle}, DIRECTOR = #{director}, ACTORS = #{actors}, GENRE = #{genre}, RELEASE_DATE = #{releaseDate,}, RUNNING_TIME = #{runningTime}, RATING = #{rating}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE MOVIE_ID = #{movieId}
